rationale: The candidate reads coherently across all four views as one stepped dominant mass, with a consistent pyramidal/cascading section and no visible view-to-view collisions. The parcel is contained, and the blue frontage edge is answered only weakly: the mass sits near the edge but the ground response is still mostly sealed. That said, for neighborhood living the form can plausibly support compact mixed-use capacity with upper hierarchy and a recognizable section. The main deficit is publicness at the access edge rather than overall typological failure. The form is not just a bounding-box extrusion; the stepped silhouette is legible and sectionally continuous, so it passes as an early massing candidate.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This is taller and more tower-like than the candidate; useful for section continuity, not for the candidate’s lower neighborhood-building scale.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stepped, tapered massing can read as one dominant object when the profile is continuous and the top resolves cleanly.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A vertical mass can express a clear primary body with a softened or slumped profile and a distinct crown.
